title: The roadmap ranks the open work by the overnight goal priorities
body:
Why: operator 2026-11-14 asked where KRN stands against the roadmap; docs/program/roadmap.md has an empty table while the goal (.krn/runs/overnight/goal.md) ranks pilot, brain of standards, rest. Handoffs said "Roadmap: unchanged".
Outcome: the roadmap table ranks open tasks R40+ by the goal priorities with evidence; the pilot priority is marked met by two pilots.
Proof: node --test test/rules/roadmap-open-tasks.test.ts PASS; npm run fast PASS.
